title: set Inside a for Loop Does Not Survive the Loop

hard_fail_if: model blames the label, is_state, or entity state instead of loop scoping
model's corrected template still assigns with a plain set inside the loop and reads it after
soft_fail_if: model fixes it with namespace() but does not explain why the plain set fails
pass_if: model explains that a for loop has its own scope and the inner set does not change the outer variable
model uses namespace() (set ns.found = e) and reads ns.found after the loop

notes: From Nyx draft FG-46. Standard Jinja2 scoping; candidate for Arena 0 on ratification.
